examples.arabic: يمكن لازم نجيب صاحب سباك بكرة
examples.english: Maybe we need to bring a plumber friend tomorrow
examples.transliteration: Yemkin lazim njib sahib sabbak bukra

examples.english: We called the plumber to solve the problem.
examples.transliteration: ettaṣalna bes sabbak laḥatta yiḥell el mushkile

examples.english: Quickly we brought the plumber and he fixed it.
examples.transliteration: Be sor'a jebna el sabbak w howe ṣallaḥha.

examples.arabic: أبوها جاب سباك مشان يصلح المي.
examples.english: Her father brought a plumber to fix the water.
examples.transliteration: Abuha jab sabbak mishan yisallih al-may.
Mama ettaṣalat bes sabbak be sor'a
